title: Bank Deposit Payout Points on Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credits
content:
Training Q&A on how **Bank Deposit** payouts earn points on a **Mobile Wallet** shortfall re-credit.

**Rule.** The Bank Deposit points of a shortfall re-credit follow the customer's Bank Deposit payouts sent in the last 12 calendar months, that is the number of their Bank Deposit payout-sent entries in that window:

| Bank Deposit payouts sent in the window | Bank Deposit points |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.20 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 6 | 0.10 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

The window is rolling: it holds the entries whose entry date lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

### Questions the rule answers
**What is counted?** Payouts sent on the customer's Bank Deposit transfers, one per payout-sent entry, not the amounts.

**Five payouts sent in the window?** At least 3 and fewer than 6: 0.10 points.

**Six payouts sent in the window?** 0.20 points.

**Today is 2026-10-04; does a payout sent on 2025-10-04 count?** No: that is 12 whole calendar months, not fewer than 12. One sent on 2025-10-05 counts.
